landChecks.label: the phone's Rust never links the core
no new sleeps in the app
the phone's eslint
landChecks.command: cd mobile/app && for f; do set -- "$@" "${f#mobile/app/}"; shift; done && node_modules/.bin/eslint --no-warn-ignored --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint-land/ "$@"

landChecks.label: the phone's Prettier
landChecks.command: cd mobile/app && for f; do set -- "$@" "${f#mobile/app/}"; shift; done && node_modules/.bin/prettier --check "$@"
landChecks.fix: cd mobile/app && for f; do set -- "$@" "${f#mobile/app/}"; shift; done && node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$@"

landChecks.label: the phones in the stores still fit the core
the Swift the wire types generate parses
landChecks.command: command -v swiftc >/dev/null || exit 0; node scripts/generate-wire-types.mjs && for f in helpers/notch/Sources/NotchKit/Wire.generated.swift mobile/ios/Sikemux/Core/Wire.generated.swift mobile/ios/Shared/Notify/Card.generated.swift mobile/ios/Shared/Glance/Glance.generated.swift; do swiftc -parse "$f" || exit 1; done

landChecks.label: the server's protocol, types and lint
landChecks.command: cd server && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline --silent && pnpm protocol:check && pnpm --filter ./protocol test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint

onCreate.label: Link the app's build outputs
onCreate.command: main="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/.."; built=packaging/binaries; if [ -e "$main/$built" ] && [ ! -e "$built" ]; then ln -s "$main/$built" "$built"; fi
